name: mirage
text: 1) Yesterday (Nov 14), engine real orders: bids 91 placed, 83 settled, +$1.29 on $31 risked; auto-bets 86 placed, 75 settled, -$6.50 on $87 risked; both averaged +3% to +3.7% edge when placed. Day total about -$5. Overall the engine is flat: 2,334 settled, -$4.77 on $1,786 (-0.3%). Best: NBA +11%, team totals +19%, moneylines +24%. Worst: college basketball -4.4%, game totals -6.1%. The LIVE lane itself is barely trading: only 11 live orders ever (-$2.13, too few to judge), live taker is off and live bids are paper. 2) I'm not lowering edge floors: at +3-4% edge the engine only breaks even, so a lower floor would add bets that likely lose. Right now the real brakes are other books' prices too old (16 of 22 looked-at bets) and the 48 h trap guard. Safer volume levers I can pull: more small bids (hundreds at 1/16 Kelly, same edge rules), and more of the types that win (NBA, team totals, moneylines) instead of college game totals. Say 'go' and I'll turn those on and log it with a revert rule; I'll also look at why prices read as too old.
